# Witch City Broom Workshops

> Hands-on broom making workshops in downtown Salem, Massachusetts. 90 minutes, $135 per person, all materials included, every maker takes a full size broom home, or has it shipped home by the workshop. Held at 32 Derby Square. Booking runs on FareHarbor. Part of the Witch City Experiences family with Witch City Walking Tours and Witch City Broom Co.

## Pages

- [Broom Making Workshops in Salem, MA](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/): Make your own full size broom in a 90 minute hands-on workshop at 32 Derby Square, Salem. $135 per person, all materials included, and we ship your broom home.
- [The Broom Making Workshop](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/workshop/): What happens in the 90 minute broom making workshop in Salem: choose a handle, wind and bind the broomcorn, stitch, add charms and ribbons, then carry it out or let us ship it home.
- [Book a Broom Making Workshop](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/book/): See open dates and times for the Salem broom making workshop and book your seat. $135 per person, small groups, secure checkout.
- [Private Broom Making Parties and Group Events](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/private-groups/): Book the Salem broom workshop for your bachelorette party, birthday, team outing or school group. Private sessions at 32 Derby Square.
- [Broom Workshop Gift Cards](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/gift-cards/): Give a seat at the Salem broom making workshop. Gift cards are emailed on purchase and redeemable on any open date.
- [Plan Your Visit to the Workshop](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/visit/): Find the workshop at 32 Derby Square in downtown Salem. Parking, what to wear, arriving early, accessibility and the cancellation policy.
- [Workshop Questions and Answers](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/faq/): Answers to the questions we hear most about the Salem broom making workshop: ages, group size, what to bring, cancellations and travel.
- [About Witch City Broom Workshops](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/about/): The makers behind the Salem broom workshop, the craft of broomcorn brooms, and the family of Witch City brands.
- [Workshop Reviews](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/reviews/): What makers say about the Salem broom making workshop, pulled from Google and TripAdvisor, with a link to leave your own.
- [Journal](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/journal/): Notes from the workshop: rainy day Salem, broom lore, gift ideas and what to do around Derby Square.
- [A Rainy Day in Salem: What to Do Indoors](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/journal/rainy-day-salem/): Ten indoor things to do in Salem when the weather turns, from museums to a broom you make yourself.
- [Contact the Workshop](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/contact/): Phone, email and address for Witch City Broom Workshops at 32 Derby Square, Salem, plus a short form for anything that is not a booking.
- [Cancellation Policy](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/cancellation-policy/): How to change or cancel a broom workshop booking and what refunds apply.
- [Accessibility](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/accessibility/): How the workshop and this website work for everyone, and how to tell us when something gets in the way.
- [Privacy](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/privacy/): What this website collects, what the booking system collects, and how to reach us about your data.
- [Terms](https://www.witchcitybroomworkshops.com/terms/): Plain terms for booking and attending a broom making workshop in Salem.

## Facts

- Address: 32 Derby Square, Salem, MA 01970
- Phone: (978) 815-0013
- Price: $135 per person
- Length: 90 minutes
- Shipping: flat rate shipping home is available for each finished broom
- All ages welcome; each maker may bring a guest to watch free of charge
- Book: https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/witchcitywalkingtours/items/538917/?full-items=yes&flow=14733
